In Hinduism, controlling the mind is a crucial aspect of spiritual growth and enlightenment. historical_references.reference: Manvendra was the son of King Manu, the lawgiver of mankind in Hindu mythology. He is considered as the founder of the Lunar Dynasty of Kings.
historical_references.context: Manvendra is a significant figure in Hindu mythology and is often considered as the first king of the Lunar Dynasty, which was one of the two major dynasties in ancient India.

historical_references.reference: Manvendra was also known as Manvendra Maharaj or Manvendra Pal. He is considered as a perfect ruler and is believed to have ruled with great wisdom and justice during his reign.
historical_references.context: Manvendra is also known from historical records as the last independent king of Gujarat's Chalukya dynasty. He is remembered for his just rule and his contributions to the development of Gujarat.
